posts.name: RySmith6
posts.cooked:
This may be overzealous of me, but I would love to see any other local players come out for an event in the Hampton Roads area!  I think it would be a blast to hang out and play the new content, maybe get to meet some others in the area who enjoy protecting The Multiverse.

I don't know when or where, but it would be neat to gauge interest for a local meeting sometime, perhaps get one of the FLGS to host an event for the WotC release. Because who doesn't love a little help saving The Multiverse?
